acceptanceCriteria: Help names the accepted typed relations and points to their normative meanings.
A focused help test confirms discoverability without changing wire vocabulary or acceptance.
body: Observed official Core1.0.0-rc.1 build163 while fixing GH426–430. corvint cem cite --help describes --relation RELATION but does not list its accepted vocabulary. Choosing definition refuses invalid-arguments and reveals call-site, decision, dependency, implementation, incident, specification, test-claim only after failure. Retained invalid citation plan and refusal in /tmp/corvint-426-428. This is a help/discoverability idea, not a defect in rejecting invalid relations; no source fix included in this batch. Dedup search cem relation returned no tickets.
title: CEM help: expose supported citation relation vocabulary
